paragraphs: One of the five sons of R' Yose ben Halafta; [Shabbat 118b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.118b.9).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara lists Rabbi Avtilas among the five sons of Rabbi Yose. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=132&lang=en) also calls him the son of Rabbi Yose ben Chalafta.
